verdict.rationale: Crawl4AI ships its own deep-crawl capability: a single CLI command (`--deep-crawl bfs --max-pages 10`) crawls outward from a start URL across multiple pages, and crash recovery (`resume_state`) and fast URL discovery (`prefetch=True`) are documented for long-running deep crawls. However, the evidence only shows a capped multi-page crawl, not a demonstrated whole-site crawl that returns aggregated content from every page in one request. missing for 10: explicit documentation of whole-site coverage (unbounded or sitemap-driven crawling of all pages), documentation of how per-page content is returned in one aggregated response, and independent hands-on corroboration of full-site crawls.

support.subject: As a developer, I can crawl an entire website and get content from all its pages with one request

citations.quote: Deep crawl crash recovery with `resume_state` and `on_state_change` callbacks for long-running crawls.
New `prefetch=True` mode for 5-10x faster URL discovery.
